description: Per-configuration run manifest for the IPM submission. Each entry binds a reported configuration to its corpus snapshot (SHA-256), model providers, decoding parameters, output directory, evaluation command, and reproduced metrics. See README_REPRODUCE.md for the canonical reproduction procedure.

global_settings.seed_note: DeepSeek and Kimi APIs do not expose a seed parameter; OpenAI's seed parameter is documented as best-effort and was not pinned in this study. All system outputs R_{c,q} are preserved verbatim under data/expanded_outputs/<config>/ and data/baselines/ so the reported metrics are reproducible from the stored outputs even though end-to-end re-generation from the raw API would not be byte-identical.
